# Each command's --help prints its summary and names its full reference

muxt check --help
stdout '^Type-checks each template against the data type'
stdout '^Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/check\.md$'

muxt fmt --help
stdout '^Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/fmt\.md$'

# muxt --help says what muxt does and where its documentation is

muxt --help
stdout '^muxt generates net/http handlers from Go HTML templates\.'
stdout '^  muxt documentation --query '
stdout '^  muxt fmt -w \.'
